title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Improved urban basic services comprising sewerage and sanitation, solid waste management, and water supply in the cities of Balykchy, Cholpon-Ata, and Karakol

By end of Project (2015): (i) Population access to safe sanitation increased from 43,000 persons in 2010 to 68,000 persons (45,000 persons through sewerage system and 23,000 persons through onsite sanitation) Progress/Status: Population access to safe sanitation increased from 43.0 thousand in 2010 to 108.6 thousand person in 2016 (73.5 thousand citizens and schools pupil through sewage system, and 35.1 thousand citizens and school pupil through onsite sanitation), This does not include number of tourist equivalent population estimated as 52.5 thousand by Consultant. Then it will be around 161.1 persons. Data Source: Annual gender-disaggregated socioeconomic surveys undertaken as part of PPMS to determine, public satisfaction with the quality of water supply, sanitation, and waste management Actual value:

(ii) Municipal solid waste collection increased to cover 133,500 persons from 61,500 persons in 2010 Progress/Status: ) In 2016 Municipal solid waste collection cover 122.5 thousand populations including 70 thousand populations in 3 cities and tourist equivalent of 52.5 thousand people. In 2017 2nd quarter additional 300 waste collection bins will be supplied that increase coverage. Data Source: National statistics for the lake water systems and water quality monitoring by the Sanitary and Epidemiological Services of the Ministry of Health Actual value:

(iii) Improved water supply ensured to already connected households Progress/Status: Improvements will be estimated by IEC consultant till December 2017. Data Source: Statistics of the State Agency on Environment Protection and Forestry
ADB project completion report Base year: 2009 Baseline value: N
